title: Realizable-solvency value leak: surplus / solvency / totalBalanceOf priced at the VAULT rate but value is only realizable at the AMM rate; skim strips the discount buffer, socializing a principal shortfall onto last-out stakers
notRegressionOf: M-01 (fixed) — DEDUP-001 is NOT the duplicate-client over-skim mechanism (structurally removed by story-041: no caller list + aggregate-surplus ceiling). Its root cause is the ceiling/solvency claim being denominated at the VAULT rate — a distinct rootCauseClass. No fingerprint match to M-01; not a regression.
description: Every economically-critical quantity (minOut, totalBalanceOf, per-client surplus, the skim aggregate-surplus ceiling, and the story-043 'provable solvency invariant') is denominated at vault.convertToAssets/convertToShares (the vault rate), but the restricted shares can only be realized at the Curve AMM rate. skimSurplus harvests the vault-rate surplus — which includes the deposit-time slippage-haircut buffer (held*p - D) that was absorbing the AMM discount — so after a skim the shares remaining to back principal are worth less than principal at the only realizable rate. Under a sustained sUSDe AMM discount (r = P_amm/P_vault < 1) the last-out staker realizes held*q < totalDeposited and eats a socialized shortfall.
impact: Last-out staker realizes less than credited principal: skimSurplus strips the over-collateralization buffer at the VAULT rate, removing the cushion that was absorbing the AMM discount. Tier-3 counterexamples log a 28.5e18 staker shortfall and a 48.5e18 last-out swing for a 3% discount; forge counterexample realizable 0.912e18 < principal 0.950e18.
attackPath: 1. Client deposits ~1e18 -> credited principal 0.95e18, held 1e18 shares (0.05e18 buffer).
2. Owner/keeper calls skimSurplus -> strips the 0.05e18 buffer shares at the vault rate; held now == principal-worth at vault rate.
3. sUSDe trades below NAV on the Curve AMM (natural sustained depeg, NOT atomic manipulation).
4. Last-out staker exits (totalWithdrawal / proportional exit) and realizes held*q < totalDeposited -> socialized shortfall.
likelihood: Conditional on an EXTERNAL precondition: sUSDe trading below NAV on the realizable venue, sustained (not closed within blocks by arbitrage). sUSDe has historically discounted several percent in stress, so the precondition is realistic in principle — BUT the magnitude/realizability that lifts this above M-02's accepted bound is UNVERIFIED pending PoC (see pocRealismContingency).
assumptions: Skim is run while a buffer exists; a sustained natural sUSDe/USDe AMM discount materializes after the skim; the discount is realized by a last-out exit rather than recovered before exit.
externalRequirements: Sustained sUSDe NAV/AMM decoupling on the Curve route. Same vault-rate-vs-AMM-rate root cause as acknowledged ledger M-02 (NAV-anchored minOut, residual bounded at slippageBps x tradeSize). DEDUP-001's distinct claim is that the skim-de-buffering mechanism BREAKS that bound.
justification: Classified MEDIUM and the High escalation is explicitly withheld (HONORED SANITIZER CAP). C4: value leak with a hypothetical attack path, stated assumptions, and an external requirement (sustained sUSDe AMM discount) -> Medium ceiling, not direct asset theft. THE CRUX / CONTINGENCY (must be preserved): run-11 audited the SAME commit 2306719 and authoritatively REJECTED the closely-related ECON-004 / M-02-run11 vault-oracle finding as a false-positive because its PoC relied on a hard-coded mock AMM decoupled from the vault price that real arbitrage / the Curve NG rate oracle would close; the residual NAV-anchored leak is the ACKNOWLEDGED M-02 bounded by slippageBps x tradeSize. DEDUP-001's claim to EXCEED that bound rests on a STILL-FAILING Tier-3 invariant (forge invariant_realizableSolvency + medusa property_realizableSolvency) whose realism is UNVERIFIED: its harness drives the AMM discount via an independently-settable MockAMMAdapter sell rate (setSellRate), i.e. exactly the hard-coded decoupling modeling concern run-11 flagged. SEVERITY IS THEREFORE CONTINGENT ON THE PoC: if the PoC demonstrates a REALISTIC, sustained, non-hard-coded sUSDe AMM discount that the NG rate oracle / arbitrage does not close, the skim-de-buffering shortfall is a genuine Medium the bounded M-02 acknowledgement does not cover; if the PoC can only reproduce the failure via a hard-coded mock discount, the finding COLLAPSES toward the already-rejected M-02-run11 false-positive (informational / invalid) and the bounded M-02 acknowledgement stands. NOT a regression of fixed M-01 (different rootCauseClass: M-01 was duplicate-client over-skim, structurally removed by story-041; DEDUP-001 attacks the RATE at which the ceiling/solvency claim is denominated). This borderline is flagged PROMINENTLY for human review.
